values/commonLabels.description: Labels to add to all deployed objects

apiReader.description:
Deploys a read-only API node which only reads from the PG DB, and does not accept
events from a stacks-blockchain node. In a HA setup, the reader is typically exposed
to the internet and serves traffic, while the writer is not exposed.

apiRosettaReader.description:
Deploys a read-only Rosetta API node which only reads from the PG DB, and does not accept
events from a stacks-blockchain node. In a HA setup, the reader is typically exposed
to the internet and serves traffic, while the writer is not exposed.
This reader gives the deployer the option of separating incoming Rosetta-bound traffic from the rest
of the traffic a reader may receive. This may be helpful for debugging purposes, or in a HA setup to ensure non-Rosetta pods
are not affected by the resource consumption and latency Rosetta endpoints may add.

apiWriter.description:
Deploys a Stacks Blockchain API which receives, processes, and stores events
from a Stacks Blockchain node into a Postgres database

workloadType.description:
Workload type for API Writer (StatefulSet or Deployment)
When set to Deployment, volumeClaimTemplates are not used and separate PVCs will be created and used instead

secrets.description:
Custom TLS certificates as secrets
NOTE: 'key' and 'certificate' are expected in PEM format
NOTE: 'name' should line up with a 'secretName' set further up
If it is not set and you're using cert-manager, this is unneeded, as it will create a secret for you with valid certificates
If it is not set and you're NOT using cert-manager either, self-signed certificates will be created valid for 365 days
It is also possible to create and manage the certificates outside of this helm chart
Please see README.md for more information
e.g:
secrets:
- name: bitcoin-core.local-tls
key: |-
...
certificate: |-
...
